## Summary

Explain the user-visible issue and what changed. Link an issue if available.

## Validation

- [ ] Web tests and build (`cd web && npm ci && npm test && npm run build`) where relevant
- [ ] Android unit tests / lint / debug build where relevant
- [ ] Emulator or physical-device test for WebView, IME, orientation or lifecycle changes
- [ ] Existing notebooks, drafts, encrypted data and import/export remain compatible
- [ ] No passwords, private notebook contents, generated assets, APKs or unapproved media
- [ ] Third-party licenses and editor provenance remain intact

## UI changes

Describe portrait and landscape results; add reviewed screenshots only if they contain no private data.
